+ * Regression test for the thread and global properties of CryptoServicesRegistrar. Setting a
+ * global property used to copy the value onto the calling thread as well, so the thread that ran
+ * the class's static initializer kept the default DSA and DH parameters, and with them the class
+ * loader that loaded Bouncy Castle, for as long as it lived (github #2536). A global value is now
+ * only copied onto a thread that already has a value of its own for the property.
+     * A thread with no values of its own that sets a global property - as the static initializer
+     * does - must be left with no thread value afterwards.
+                isTrue("global set left a thread value", CryptoServicesRegistrar.clearThreadProperty(DSA) == null);
+     * A thread that has its own value sees a global set it makes itself.
+    private void threadValueUpdatedOnGlobalSet(final DSAParameters[] threadValue, final DSAParameters[] globalValue)
+                isTrue("cleared thread value still present", CryptoServicesRegistrar.clearThreadProperty(DSA) == null);
+     * A thread that set a global value without a value of its own sees a later global set made
+     * by another thread, rather than a stale copy of its own.
+    private void globalSetFromOtherThreadVisible(final DSAParameters[] first, final DSAParameters[] second)
+     * Clearing a property on a thread with no values returns null without leaving anything behind.
+    private static void runOnNewThread(final Check check)

- The BC provider's stream ciphers (ChaCha20, XChaCha20, Salsa20 and the rest) and key wrap ciphers (AESWrap, AESWrapPad and the other algorithms' wrap modes) accepted an AEADParameterSpec, which extends IvParameterSpec, as a plain IV, so the MAC size and associated data it carried were silently ignored. They now reject it with the InvalidAlgorithmParameterException the block ciphers already throw for non-AEAD modes. A plain IvParameterSpec, or a subclass carrying no extra data, is unaffected.

- Blake2bpDigest.getByteLength() returned 0 rather than the 128 byte BLAKE2b block size the digest distributes to its four leaves, so anything deriving a block size from it, HMac included, could not be used with BLAKE2bp. It now returns 128, matching Blake2spDigest, which already returned its 64 byte block size (github #2538).

- CMSAuthenticatedDataParser.getUnauthAttrs() always returned null, as its constructor never marked the unauthenticated attributes as unread, and the AuthenticatedDataParser beneath it cast the streamed element to ASN1TaggedObject rather than ASN1TaggedObjectParser, so once reached it threw ClassCastException. The streaming parser now returns the unauthenticated attributes as the non-streaming CMSAuthenticatedData does (github #2532).

+- CryptoServicesRegistrar.setGlobalProperty(), and the class's static initializer through the same path, also stored the value as a thread property of the calling thread, so the thread that first used CryptoServicesRegistrar kept the default DSA and DH parameters - and with them the class loader that loaded Bouncy Castle - for as long as it lived, preventing a discarded web application or plugin class loader from being collected. A global value is now copied only onto a thread that already has a value of its own for the property, and clearing the last thread property removes the thread's property map. A thread that set a global value now also sees a later global value set by another thread, rather than keeping its own copy. Relates to github #2536.
